modes.local: full coverage executes or reuses an exact validated receipt; full verification and checkpoint may admit its complete product test execution
modes.candidate: full coverage executes in Fast proof and seals the complete canonical reports
modes.release: exact Fast proof admission and inherited report hashes; no coverage execution fallback
modes.checkpoint: Ambiguous existing focused scope may reuse exact full product coverage with its own full runtime/execution identity and sealed report bytes; current changed/new-file thresholds still apply.

digests: canonical production source inventory and contents
product and tooling test inventory, Vitest setup, harness, support, and helper contents
coverage scope, thresholds, configuration, and owner implementation
every canonical JSON, LCOV, and HTML report file
complete full-unit runtime and execution fingerprint of the coverage producer, including excluded runtime sources and actual pool
proof: Only successfully validated full product coverage may write the receipt; every blocking consumer recomputes all input and report digests.
rollback: Delete the disposable Fast proof and rerun ci:proof to force full coverage.
collisionCheck: Receipt and reports are materialized atomically only under canonical disposable paths.
